title: My Power Level Said Zero.
summary: A young throne-room sweeper touches the Power Stone, and his zero reading climbs past the king to infinity.
frame_0: The sweeper rests his block hand on the cracked obsidian Power Stone. Light pours from the seam under a gold infinity symbol, with the crowned Prince and King behind him.
camera: Steady cuts on Testing Day, with shots changing as the spoken subject changes.
